title: Live imaging of Drosophila melanogaster neural stem cells with photo-ablated centrosomes
protocol: Start collecting wandering third instar larvae 96–120 h after egg laying using fine forceps.
Leave each larva in 0.1 mL drops of PBS for subsequent brain dissection.
Wash the larvae three times in PBS and transfer them into 200 μL of culture media.
Remove the brain from the larvae under a binocular microscope using fine tweezers.
Separate the brain from the salivary glands and surrounding tissues.
Mount the dissected brain on an incubation chamber.
Gently aspirate the brain with a 200 μL Eppendorf pipet tip containing 50 μL of culture media.
Transfer the brain to the central well of the incubation chamber.
Cover the brain with 200 μL of mineral oil in the incubation chamber.
Aspirate excess culture medium using a fine homemade glass capillary through the mineral oil layer.
Cut the end of the pipette tip off with a razor blade before aspiration.
Stop aspiration as soon as the brain lobes start to flatten under the binocular microscope.
Image larval brain explants under an inverted Leica SP5 confocal microscope maintained at 25°C.
Perform photo-ablation with a Mai-Tai two-photon infrared laser on a 2 × 2 μm region of interest at the centrosome in metaphase cells.
Record NSC divisions with a 60 × 1.3 NA objective.
Acquire ten Z-series of 1 μm steps at 700 Hz just before and after photo-ablation at 30 s intervals.
Acquire images in 8 bits, 512 × 512 pixels, with 2 frame-average.
Gently aspirate the photo-ablated brain using a Pasteur pipette containing 50 μL of culture medium.
Transfer the brain directly into 1 mL of fresh fixative solution.
Return the tube three times and incubate at 25°C for 20 min.
Wash the fixed sample three times for 10 min on a rotating wheel in 1 mL of PBST.
Process the brain for immunofluorescence using rabbit anti-Cnn, rat anti-tubulin, and mouse anti-phosphorylated Histone H3 (Ser10) antibodies.
Analyze NSCs divisions using the Fiji (ImageJ) software.
Visualize the NCS and the GMC outskirts using the plasma membrane PH-PLCδ-GFP marker.
Measure the diameters of the newborn NSC and the GMC after cytokinesis using the “line” tool on Fiji.
Perform at least two diameter measurements for each cell.
Make movies in controls and photo-ablated NSCs using Fiji.
Plot the data and perform appropriate statistical analyses using Prism.
Select relevant time-lapse images to make figures or export into videos.
